title: From retail to real estate

captions.instagram:
After the Wiz, I moved from stores to land.

I turned to waterfront revitalization and real estate development, assembling underutilized parcels across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and New Jersey. That work led to JemRock Organization and our mission: change how the world produces housing.

Save the 5 questions before redeveloping a property.

captions.linkedin:
The skills that grow a retail chain are site skills.

After the Wiz, I moved into waterfront revitalization and real estate development, assembling underutilized parcels across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and New Jersey. That work led to JemRock Organization, where our mission is to change how the world produces housing at global scale.

How I'd map it: location analysis becomes reading a neighborhood, lease decisions become property decisions, traffic planning becomes future demand, buildouts become feasibility.

#RealEstate #Leadership
